findings.claim: The loop stops before the last attempt, so the third failure is never reported.
findings.evidence: for (let i = 1; i < attempts; i++) never reaches i === attempts.

findings.claim: An empty header line now throws instead of returning no fields.
findings.evidence: split(':')[1].trim() runs on undefined when the line has no colon.

findings.claim: The usage example still shows the old flag name.
Two tasks with the same name share a cache entry across runs.
findings.evidence: A script that ran both tasks printed the same key twice.

findings.claim: The timeout may fire before the child process starts.
findings.evidence: Read of the code; a rerun with a slow start did not show it.

findings.claim: The queue drops a job when two workers claim it at once.
findings.evidence: claim() reads and writes the row without a lock.

findings.claim: The error message hides the job id.
findings.evidence: throw new Error('failed') carries no id.
